{{Quote|The only problem that these mines had was how fast the Empire came down on Mesonics after a few explosions wiped out some high-placed Moffs.|[[Fal'Orssk]]|<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
'''Mesonics''' was a company that produced explosive devices for both military and civilian clients during the reigns of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Mesonics [[E-Mag Explosive Mine]] was used to [[Death/Legends|kill]] several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]]. Because of this, the Empire effectively assumed control of Mesonics's facilities by sending [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to guard them. In exchange for retaining some autonomy, Mesonics officials agreed to directly supply the Empire and to grant Imperial officials the right to deny outside purchases of the mines. The Empire denied all such purchases, but some Mesonics employees sold the mines on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="GFT" />

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] came into power this restriction was lifted, though the new government carefully monitored transactions involving dangerous Mesonics products.<ref name="GFT" /> During this period Mesonics was known to sell to agricultural corporations as well as to military and paramilitary groups.<ref name="BFH" />

[[File:E-mag_mine_SWJ3.png|thumb|right|200px|[[E-Mag Explosive Mine]]]]

Their devices were difficult to use because they required detonators that fired at triple frequency intervals.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|309|Mesonics}}</ref>
